guides.title: 工程操作與定量驗證手冊
guides.concept: 本課以慢砂構造、級配、生物成熟與刮砂復原為主線，從原水適用性與前處理、池體尺寸與材料數量、篩分析與級配驗收、承托與集水均勻性進入十個相連的技術單元。每單元依機制、數量模型、驗證與失效辨識逐步操作，最後完成包含單位、敏感度及邊界的工程工作單。數值均為原創教學假設，不是特定設施實測或現場操作設定。
guides.conceptEn: This course develops slow-sand construction, grading, biological ripening and scraping recovery through ten connected units, beginning with source suitability and pretreatment, cell geometry and material quantities, sieve analysis and grading acceptance, support and collection uniformity. Each unit moves through mechanism, quantitative model, verification and failure diagnosis, ending in a worksheet with units, sensitivity and applicability. All example numbers are original teaching assumptions, not facility measurements or live operating settings.

evidence: 在離線工作台先選取「原水適用性與前處理」的觀測點。比較水頭、濁度與生物層成熟期的水質趨勢。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「池體尺寸與材料數量」的觀測點。量完成面積與多點砂深，並核對材料檢驗紀錄。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「篩分析與級配驗收」的觀測點。重畫篩分析曲線並以插值核對 D10、D60。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「承托與集水均勻性」的觀測點。以多層測壓資料區分表面及深床壓損。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「水層與孔隙停留」的觀測點。用示蹤比較平均孔隙停留與早期突破。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「生物層建立與證據」的觀測點。列出方法回收率、重複樣本與未檢出上限。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「緩慢增阻與水力限制」的觀測點。以多層測壓資料區分表面及深床壓損。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「刮砂與材料庫存」的觀測點。記錄刮除前後標高與剩餘砂深。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「復原期與出水去向」的觀測點。列出方法回收率、重複樣本與未檢出上限。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「分池備援與長期記錄」的觀測點。比較水頭、濁度與生物層成熟期的水質趨勢。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
evidenceEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for source suitability and pretreatment. Compare head, turbidity and water quality through biological-layer maturation. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for cell geometry and material quantities. Measure finished plan area and sand depth at multiple locations and check material-test records. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for sieve analysis and grading acceptance. Replot sieve results and check interpolated D10 and D60. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for support and collection uniformity. Use multi-level piezometry to distinguish surface and deep-bed head loss. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for water layer and pore residence. Use a tracer to compare mean pore residence with early breakthrough. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for biofilm establishment and evidence. Record method recovery, replicates and nondetect upper bounds. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for progressive resistance and hydraulic limits. Use multi-level piezometry to distinguish surface and deep-bed head loss. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for scraping and media inventory. Record pre/post-scrape levels and remaining sand depth. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for recovery period and water routing. Record method recovery, replicates and nondetect upper bounds. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for multiple-cell redundancy and long-term records. Compare head, turbidity and water quality through biological-layer maturation. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
pitfalls: 高濁事件仍假設平日負荷與濾程。診斷與介入：以成熟且在線的實際面積核算，維護時重新比較負荷。
只按砂體積建造而未留出排水與維護空間。診斷與介入：多點量實際砂深，另列承托層、孔隙與施工餘量。
只比一個粒徑平均值。診斷與介入：查完整篩分析曲線與材料一致性，不能只比 UC。
總出水正常卻忽略局部集中通流。診斷與介入：使用多層測壓區分表層生物膜與深床阻力。
把池內全部水量當成均等的有效生物接觸。診斷與介入：核對孔隙率、砂深及示蹤分布，另驗證生物成熟。
新建或刮砂後直接沿用成熟濾床表現。診斷與介入：核對檢出限及水力配對，對未檢出結果使用可支持的下限。
只增加水頭掩蓋堵塞趨勢。診斷與介入：使用多層測壓區分表層生物膜與深床阻力。
多次刮砂後仍使用初始砂深建模。診斷與介入：逐次記錄刮砂及剩餘深度，以水質證據判讀復原。
壓損恢復便忽略生物去除能力。診斷與介入：核對檢出限及水力配對，對未檢出結果使用可支持的下限。
維護造成在線面積減少卻仍按全池容量供水。診斷與介入：以成熟且在線的實際面積核算，維護時重新比較負荷。
pitfallsEn: A high-turbidity event is assumed to have normal loading and run length. Diagnostic response: Use actually mature, online area and reassess loading during maintenance.

Construction follows sand volume alone without drainage or maintenance space. Diagnostic response: Measure sand depth at several positions and separately list support layers, voids and construction allowances.
Only a mean grain size is compared. Diagnostic response: Check the full sieve curve and consistency rather than UC alone.
Normal total output hides localized flow concentration. Diagnostic response: Use multi-level piezometry to separate surface-biofilm from deep-bed resistance.
All water volume is treated as equally effective biological contact. Diagnostic response: Check porosity, sand depth and tracer distribution and verify maturity separately.
A new or scraped bed is assumed to retain mature-bed performance. Diagnostic response: Check detection limits/hydraulic pairing and use supportable lower bounds for nondetection.
Increasing head conceals clogging trends. Diagnostic response: Use multi-level piezometry to separate surface-biofilm from deep-bed resistance.
The initial bed depth remains in the model after repeated scraping. Diagnostic response: Record each scraping/remaining depth and assess recovery using quality evidence.
Restored head loss is mistaken for restored biological removal. Diagnostic response: Check detection limits/hydraulic pairing and use supportable lower bounds for nondetection.
Reduced online area during maintenance is ignored in supply planning. Diagnostic response: Use actually mature, online area and reassess loading during maintenance.

history.title: 慢砂濾池建造
history.text: 本課以公開技術手冊建立方法背景；來源出版年代不代表此程序首次發明的年代。舊版文件僅提供原理與歷史脈絡，現場工作仍須確認當地現行規定與設備文件。
history.textEn: Public technical manuals establish the methodological background; publication dates do not identify the invention date. Older documents provide principles and historical context, while real work still requires current local requirements and equipment documentation.

courses.connection: 本課以慢砂構造、級配、生物成熟與刮砂復原為主線，從原水適用性與前處理、池體尺寸與材料數量、篩分析與級配驗收、承托與集水均勻性進入十個相連的技術單元。每單元依機制、數量模型、驗證與失效辨識逐步操作，最後完成包含單位、敏感度及邊界的工程工作單。數值均為原創教學假設，不是特定設施實測或現場操作設定。
courses.connectionEn: This course develops slow-sand construction, grading, biological ripening and scraping recovery through ten connected units, beginning with source suitability and pretreatment, cell geometry and material quantities, sieve analysis and grading acceptance, support and collection uniformity. Each unit moves through mechanism, quantitative model, verification and failure diagnosis, ending in a worksheet with units, sensitivity and applicability. All example numbers are original teaching assumptions, not facility measurements or live operating settings.
